title: Review pattern
description: The frontmatter of one pattern page in the review ledger: a recurring class of problem reviewers keep raising, not a single bug. The judge supplies only prose (title, problem, root cause, fix) and which events match; every field here that is a count, a list of sources, a status or an id is computed by the runtime from the events the evidence gate kept (ruling learning-judge-is-runner-bound; protocol evidence-gate). A pattern is 'active' once its count reaches the configured active threshold and its evidence includes either a direct human correction or two distinct non-bot reviewers across independent pull requests or sources; one repeated drive-by account and bot-only authors remain 'candidate'. 'Retired' is sticky and only a human sets or clears it. Promotion at the promote threshold writes a guardrail draft, never published knowledge (ruling learning-drafts-not-publishes).

count.description: Events counted against this page. An event is counted once however often it is replayed.

last_seen.description: Empty until the first event is counted.

promoted_to.description: 'guardrails' once promoted to a guardrail draft; empty otherwise. Rollback of a promotion clears it.

team_target.description: A repository-relative path of a tracked team file the rule belongs in, proposed by the judge and offered to a human as a draft. The runtime never writes it.
